comparison.objective: Extract one decommissioned cable from a clipped live bundle, versus commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective deformable extraction through two clips while preserving neighboring cables versus rigid hex-key/collar manipulation and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Blue cable must be fully outside the tray and released while three live cables remain clipped under both clips; candidate requires safe repeated impacts and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Selective cable disentanglement tests deformable manipulation, not adjustable damping.
